short_description: Berlin-headquartered German quick-commerce (grocery-delivery) company (founded 2020 by Oliver Merkel, Christoph Cordes, Julian Dames and Nikolas Bullwinkel) that operates its own network of dark-store fulfilment centres to deliver groceries and everyday essentials to customers in Germany, the Netherlands and neighbouring European markets; reached widely reported unicorn valuation in December 2021 after a US$750M DoorDash-led Series B.
